lifecycle.admission: all IDs, channel/context/source/cue limits validated before filesystem/device work; cue budget private to group
lifecycle.startup: sequential opening; later failure cancels/joins already-started inputs
lifecycle.stop: quiesce all captures before any file-worker completion join
lifecycle.publication: sync whole manifest in staging; atomic no-overwrite hardlink to completed.json; sync directory
lifecycle.failure: no partial group result; retain every available per-input outcome and original
lifecycle.recovery: plan.json and per-take group/track context; load_completed returns all clips or error
lifecycle.postLinkSyncError: manifest can remain visible with uncertain durability; explicit error requires reconciliation

tests.normalStop: two exact 159-frame stereo takes including 31-frame tails; every capture finish asserts no earlier take.wav is published
startupRollback: second capture factory fails after first records128frames
second cue rack fails before second capture opens; first is cancelled
failures: later stop fails; first clean WAV retained but no complete group manifest
raw fault/cancel/Drop stops all inputs and retains recoverable128-frame prefixes
cue consumer disconnect leaves complete dry group
duplicate IDs, invalid late config and combined source/cue budgets rejected before opening
restart: duplicate tracks/audio paths including dot aliases rejected
traversing paths, frame mismatch and known manifest/audio symlinks rejected
tests.abruptExit: parent executes ignored child support fixture; child completes first take then process::exit(0) skips remaining Group/Session/Recorder Drop; parent finds one take.wav, no completed.json and rejects whole-group reload; no claim for uncheckpointed second PCM

qualificationLimits: Group results are eligible for a future project transaction; actual project insertion/Undo is not integrated

App-owned storage assumed; not a hostile filesystem or cryptographic authentication boundary
Installed app remains Web Audio capture with buffered native cue
